`src/mp_palmdet.py` and `src/mp_handpose.py` are copied unchanged from OpenCV Zoo
(https://huggingface.co/opencv/palm_detection_mediapipe and
https://huggingface.co/opencv/handpose_estimation_mediapipe), Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).
They wrap Google MediaPipe's palm detection and hand landmark models, downloaded by
`scripts/get_models.sh` into `models/`.
